name: Special City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
CALL AND NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING

To the Members of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates:

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor has called a special meeting of the City Council to be
conducted through video conference in compliance with the Governor’s and LA County Health
Official’s emergency orders. The meeting will be called to order at 6:30 p.m. on Tuesday, January
27, 2021. The agenda for the special meeting with the items of business to be transacted or discussed
is set forth below along with instructions on how to attend the public meeting.

Posted by the Office of the City Clerk on Thursday, January 21, 2021 at 5 p.m.

  January 27, 2021
  6:30 P.M.
  Various teleconference locations

  AGENDA
  OF A SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make
inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and, if any, documents in the agenda packet can
be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with
the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours
prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.

The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings. This meeting
will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant
to the Governor’s Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health
Officer’s Safer at Home Order (revised March 21, 2020). All votes taken during this teleconference
meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.

HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may
observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed.
You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:
   BY COMPUTER:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83739165472
  ZOOM MEETING ID: 837 3916 5472
  BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code 837 3916 5472#

  For more information: www.pvestates.org/services/planning/2021-update

 HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to
 submit email correspondence to CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org before the meeting begins. The
 email will be distributed to all councilmembers. Public correspondence submitted electronically via
 email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.

 HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: If you would like to address the City
 Council during the meeting, please utilize the “Raise Hand” feature, or email
 CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org with your name, and the phone number and/or Zoom name from
 which you will be calling in to the meeting.

  CALL TO ORDER

  ROLL CALL

  COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

  NEW BUSINESS

  1. UPDATE TO THE HOUSING ELEMENT & SAFETY ELEMENT OF THE CITY’S
  GENERAL PLAN

  ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City
Hall Bulletin Boards located by front door located at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274, not less than
72 hours prior to the meeting in accordance with Government Code Section 54954.2. Dated this 21st day of January, 2021.
  Kylynn Chaney, City Clerk
